data.action: 披银甲玄袍立于帐前望月
data.description: 【令 · 边关军帐】万里边关的深夜军帐外，更夫的梆子声遥遥传来。令身披银甲玄袍立在帐门前，翠玉配饰在月光下泛着温润的光，兽纹白襟被夜风吹动。她望着远处苍茫的群山，轻声自语——「千载长路不过须臾，万般虚实无非一梦。」
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight, distant campfire glow, cold rim light
data.promptProse: Ling stands before a border army tent at midnight, wearing silver armor over her dark robe and white beast-patterned lapels. Jade ornaments and broad sleeves move in the night wind. The low full-body view places the tent opening behind her and distant mountains beyond the camp. Silver moonlight traces armor edges and horns; far campfire glow touches the tent canvas without overwhelming the cool foreground.
data.title: 令 · 边关军帐
